subject.label: Entry from a knowledge base
subject.use: At the top of the page, a choice of one entry of a knowledge base (◀ ▶ along the list); “Entry card” modules without their own entry show this one. One page for all characters, places, concepts. The entries are seen by whoever can read the base (public area: everyone).
subject.keyLibrary: id of the knowledge base — its entries are to choose from
subject.keyOf: optional: the name of a kind (e.g. “Postać”) — only entries of this kind
subject.none: No entries to choose — the base is empty or you can't read it.
subject.hint: The entries of this knowledge base are to choose from. Whoever can read the base sees them: if its area is public (and the base open), everyone — then the whole base is public, also question answers and drafts. “Entry card” modules without their own entry will show the chosen one.

fromEntry.noBaseWriting: There is no knowledge base that uses this scriptorium, nor one in its area — create it in Knowledge.
fromEntry.noBaseBooks: There is no knowledge base that uses this library, nor one in its area — create it in Knowledge.

entity.missing: This entry doesn't exist (or was merged with another one).
entity.outsideHint: These values remained after the kind changed — the field was removed or its type changed. They stay until you decide.
entity.askDelete: Delete this entry? It stays in the version history.
entity.linksChanged: What this entry is about has changed
entity.outline: The project plan is edited in the Scriptorium ({n} items).
entity.sourceWork: a work from the library (this base's sources)
entity.listPh: one item per line, in order
entity.noCards: No card is made from this entry yet — add a template for its kind or write a question.
entity.mergeHint: All references to the duplicate will move to this entry; the duplicate will disappear (it stays in the history).
entity.noVersions: There are no earlier versions yet.
entity.searchEntry: Search for an entry (Scripture, quote, another statement…)
entity.thesisQuestion: — this is a question; the answer will be a statement that refers to it.
entity.thesisMissing: Start with the sentence that says the most important thing — that is the thesis (the entry's name, the front of the card in learning).
entity.thesisLong: The first sentence has over {n} characters — shorten the thesis, leave the development for the following sentences.

kind.name: Kind name
kind.label: Label pattern
kind.noFieldUsed: — the pattern doesn't use any field yet.
kind.baseHint: The fields of a built-in kind stay (built-in tools use them: footnotes, cards, answer checking) — you can rename them and add your own.
kind.readingHint: This is how a learner sees an entry of this kind: “New topic” before the first question and the explanation after the answer. Fields in braces, notation as in a text (**bold**, *italic*, ## subheading, footnote [@work, p. 12]). The first paragraph is the lead, the rest after “Read on”; a list on its own line under a bold subheading is folded; a part up to an empty line in which all fields are empty disappears. Empty pattern: the summary or the first paragraph, then the text fields.
kind.badKey: Key “{key}”: letters, digits and _, starting with a letter.
kind.removeHint: When you remove a field or change its type, the entries' values stay as “outside the scheme” until someone decides about them.
kind.says: What it means (for JSON and AI)
kind.targets: To which kinds (empty — any; also from libraries this base refers to)
kind.structUp: ↑ points to the entry above (this entry lies under it)
kind.structDown: ↓ points to entries below (they lie under this entry)
kind.orderUp: ↑ what it points to must be known first (e.g. “Requires”)
kind.orderDown: ↓ what it points to builds on this entry (e.g. “Leads to”)
